item.title: #1: Does RFSoC design still need a whole team?
item.description: RFSoC design asks for RF, FPGA and software skills at once. In my talk at AMD on Wheels New Zealand, AI agents engineered a working radio link on one board. What used to require a team of engineers now requires one.
item.author: joachim.cain@avnet.com (Joachim Cain)
